_doc: Per-user registry for the Cloud SuperApp full-config artifact. The derive engine emits ONE build-cloud-superapp-<slug>.json per key here, so adding a user is a DATA addition — no code change. `profile` maps 1:1 onto the app's ProfilePrefs keys (name, email, initials, company, location, website, titles_v2, picture_uri, banner_uri); `wireguard_profiles` names entries in superapp-wireguard-profiles.json.
_security: NO SECRETS IN THIS FILE. This repo is PUBLIC. WireGuard private keys are never carried by the artifact — see superapp-wireguard-profiles.json.
